heart_rate.label: Heart rate
heart_rate.why_in_space: NASA HRP identifies cardiovascular adaptations as a risk: microgravity changes blood circulation and the function of the heart and blood vessels.

bp_systolic.label: Systolic blood pressure
bp_systolic.what: Pressure in the arteries when the heart contracts.
bp_systolic.why_in_space: Related to the risk of cardiovascular adaptations identified by NASA HRP.

bp_diastolic.label: Diastolic blood pressure
bp_diastolic.what: Pressure in the arteries between heartbeats.
bp_diastolic.why_in_space: Related to the risk of cardiovascular adaptations identified by NASA HRP.

glucose.label: Blood glucose
glucose.what: Amount of sugar in the blood.
glucose.why_in_space: NASA HRP identifies the risk of inadequate nutrition during long missions.

temperature.label: Body temperature
temperature.why_in_space: NASA HRP identifies a risk of altered immune responses (e.g., reactivation of dormant viruses).

sleep_hours.label: Sleep
sleep_hours.what: Amount of sleep in the last 24 hours.
sleep_hours.why_in_space: NASA HRP identifies the risk of inadequate sleep and irregular schedules.

mood.label: Mood (self-reported)
mood.what: A self-assessment from 1 (very poor) to 5 (very good). This is not a clinical scale.
mood.why_in_space: NASA HRP identifies the risk of behavioral changes related to isolation and confinement.
